sources.title: 第4次静岡市総合計画
sources.review_boundary: The council-approved basic concept and basic plan landing is verified. Policy indicators, target definitions, denominators, and page-level evidence remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 第4次静岡市総合計画 前期実施計画
sources.review_boundary: The rolling first implementation plan is verified as the current implementation layer. Individual projects, annual revisions, project costs, and fiscal links require record-level review.

sources.title: 令和8年度当初予算（案）の概要
sources.review_boundary: The official initial-budget document is verified. Prior-year February supplementary amounts, debt-authorized amounts, approved budget values, and project-level financing remain separate evidence states.

sources.title: 決算
sources.review_boundary: The fiscal 2024 major-policy-results and settlement publication route is verified. General, special, enterprise, audit-opinion, and financial-health records remain separate until record-level review.

unresolved_layers.boundary: Individual sector plans publish progress reports, but a canonical citywide annual progress or policy-measure evaluation landing for the fourth comprehensive plan has not yet been resolved. Sector-plan progress must not be substituted for overall comprehensive-plan progress.

quality_boundary: This partial inventory confirms the current comprehensive plan, first implementation plan, fiscal 2026 initial-budget document, and fiscal 2024 settlement publication route. It does not infer a citywide annual-progress source from sector-specific reports and does not promote indicators, project execution, budget values, settlement values, or outcomes to Reviewed, linked, comparable, or policy-achievement status.
next_action: Resolve the canonical citywide annual progress or policy-measure evaluation source for the fourth comprehensive plan, then map plan indicators, implementation projects, fiscal 2026 budget records, and fiscal 2024 settlement records at page-level evidence depth without substituting sector-plan evaluations.
